title: Docker sandbox provider for `osf sandbox run`
summary: Adds a provider-neutral sandbox seam (`Sandbox` trait, spec/command validation, an in-memory fake) and one concrete adapter that drives the local `docker` CLI: create a hardened container, run one command inside it, then always remove it. A new `osf sandbox run` subcommand plans the run, can print the exact argv as a dry run, and executes it with signal handling so SIGINT/SIGTERM remove the container before osf exits.

nodes.label: sandbox_run_cmd
nodes.subtitle: fn sandbox_run_cmd(&SandboxRunArgs) -> ExitCode
nodes.summary: Checks that --repo and --state are existing folders, builds a RunRequest, plans it, then either prints the dry-run JSON or executes the plan and maps the result to an exit code.

nodes.label: SandboxRunArgs
nodes.subtitle: clap Args
nodes.summary: The flags of `osf sandbox run`: image, repo, state, network, user, timeout, name, dry-run and the trailing command words.

nodes.label: sandbox_cli
nodes.subtitle: plan / dry_run_json / run_plan
nodes.summary: Turns a RunRequest into a validated Plan, renders the exact docker argv for a dry run, and executes the plan over the Sandbox seam with a tracker that a signal can reach.

nodes.label: SandboxTracker
nodes.subtitle: current id + stop flag + gates
nodes.summary: Holds the sandbox id in use, a stopping flag and two mutexes so a signal stop waits for an in-flight create and only one removal runs at a time.

nodes.label: stop_signal
nodes.subtitle: SIGINT / SIGTERM watcher
nodes.summary: Installs async-signal-safe handlers that record the last signal in an atomic; the run loop polls it and removes the sandbox before exiting with 128+signal.

nodes.label: Sandbox trait
nodes.subtitle: create / run / destroy / capabilities
nodes.summary: The provider-neutral seam: create a sandbox from a spec, run one command, destroy it, and report what the provider can do. Destroying an unknown sandbox is AlreadyGone.

nodes.label: SandboxSpec / CommandSpec
nodes.subtitle: spec, mounts, limits, env, stdin
nodes.summary: The data the seam carries. CommandSpec's Debug and serde print environment keys and the stdin length only, never a value.

nodes.label: validate
nodes.subtitle: validate_spec / validate_command
nodes.summary: Every check runs before any provider call: pinned image, non-root user, absolute workdir, safe mounts, sane limits, valid env keys and no NUL values.

nodes.label: FakeSandbox
nodes.subtitle: in-memory double
nodes.summary: Records every create/run/destroy/capabilities call as plain data and answers from memory, so engine-style tests reach no process, file, network or clock.

nodes.label: DockerSandbox
nodes.subtitle: impl Sandbox for DockerSandbox<R>
nodes.summary: Implements the seam over a DockerRunner: create then start then a uid check, exec with a timeout, kill on timeout, inspect-then-remove on destroy, and three capability probes.

nodes.label: argv builders
nodes.subtitle: create_argv / exec_argv / kill_argv / remove_argv
nodes.summary: Pure functions that build each docker invocation. Environment values never enter the argv: exec names the variables and the values travel in the client process environment.

nodes.label: RealDockerRunner
nodes.subtitle: spawns the docker program
nodes.summary: Spawns the client in its own process group, reads both pipes on threads with a per-stream cap that keeps the first and last half, waits with a timeout and kills the whole tree when it expires.

nodes.label: resolve_mounts
nodes.subtitle: canonicalize + refuse system paths
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes every mount source, refusing a missing source, an unfollowed symlink, the host root, /run, /var/run, /proc, a top-level socket, and a source that is or holds the repository mount.

nodes.label: docker CLI
nodes.subtitle: create / start / exec / kill / rm / inspect
nodes.summary: The installed docker client the adapter shells out to, one invocation per operation.

nodes.label: docker daemon
nodes.subtitle: container runtime
nodes.summary: The daemon that actually creates, starts and removes the container; the adapter only reads its stdout and stderr.

steps.heading: The new subcommand
steps.body: `osf sandbox run` checks the two folders and builds a request.

detail.text: The CLI validates --repo and --state, then hands a RunRequest to the host-side planner.

steps.heading: Plan and validate
steps.body: The request becomes a spec and a command, checked before any docker call.

detail.text: plan() builds the SandboxSpec and CommandSpec and runs the shared validators, so a refusal never reaches a tool.

steps.heading: Execute over the seam
steps.body: create, run, then always destroy, through the Sandbox trait.

detail.text: execute_tracked drives the Sandbox trait and records the sandbox id so a signal stop can find it.

steps.heading: Docker adapter
steps.body: Pure argv builders, mount vetting and a runner that spawns the client.

detail.text: The adapter builds each docker argv, canonicalizes mount sources, and the runner spawns the client with a timeout and a process-group kill.

steps.heading: Stoppable
steps.body: SIGINT or SIGTERM removes the sandbox before osf exits.

detail.text: The signal watcher records the signal; the run loop removes the tracked sandbox and exits with 128 plus the signal number.
